ios.desc:
Detail combines the simplicity of a camera app with the power of a professional AI video editor. Whether you're creating a 60-second reaction video, a polished YouTube vlog, a 30-minute interview or podcast, or going live to thousands of viewers, you can do it all in one place with Detail.


INSTANT VIDEO WITH AI AUTO-EDIT

Record or import a video and let AI Auto-Edit do the rest. Detail's AI finds the best moments, removes silences, and creates ready-to-share shorts and reels automatically. Instant video — record, done.


AI DIRECTOR — YOUR PERSONAL TELEPROMPTER

Stay on script with AI Director, your conversational teleprompter guide. It listens as you speak and keeps you on track, so every take is your best take. Perfect for content creators, educators, and presenters.


MULTICAM RECORDING

Turn your iPhone and iPad into a multi-camera video studio. Record from multiple angles simultaneously and switch between them in real time. Professional multicam production without the professional price tag.


REACTION VIDEOS MADE EASY

Record split-screen reaction videos to any content in seconds. Import a video, hit record, and share your reaction with the world. The fastest way to create reaction content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.


PODCAST & VIDEO PODCAST STUDIO

Record, edit, and publish professional video podcasts. Detail handles layouts, audio levels, and transitions so you can focus on the conversation. Support for remote guests and multi-camera setups.


LIVESTREAMING TO ANY PLATFORM

Go live to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, or any RTMP destination directly from Detail. Add overlays, switch cameras, and engage your audience — all from your iPhone or iPad.


GREEN SCREEN & CHROMA KEY

Remove or replace your background instantly with green screen support. No physical green screen needed — Detail's AI handles background removal automatically.


AI AUTO-CAPTIONS & SUBTITLES

Add accurate auto captions in 50+ languages. Customize fonts, colors, and styles. Captions are fully editable and can be exported as separate subtitle files. Transcribe your content with a single tap.


PROFESSIONAL EDITING TOOLS

• Trim, cut, and split clips with precision

• Add text, stickers, and overlays

• Apply filters, effects, and color grading

• Adjust speed — slow motion, time-lapse, and more

• 4K video export for maximum quality

• Music and sound effects library

show_hn.title: Show HN: Use 2 iPhones to Record Auto-Synced Multicam Video

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

We've been working on "Multiplayer" for Detail, allowing you to set up and connect two iPhones to each other (P2P or WiFi) and record a multi-angle podcast, interview, or unboxing video easily. After filming, the local recordings from each device are synced, so both devices end up with high-quality camera angles and audio that you can edit and remix. We're also working on remote connections (WebRTC-based) and improving audio alignment on slow networks using cross-correlation.

With Detail and Multiplayer, you can bypass the need for multiple cameras and complicated audio setups. Just grab two iPhones, connect them, and start recording.

Let us know what you think! Happy to answer any questions about how it works.

Marketing page: https://detail.co/multiplayer

App store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1673518618?pt=122522774&ct=hn&mt=8
